component: Exchange new-mail Biff lifecycle and notification consumer

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: PerformBiff sets performingBiff before syncing the hierarchy and descendant folders. A shared listener records folder URIs and clears that flag only after their stop callbacks are marked done; it does not require successful exit codes. Folder new-message count and BiffState feed the notification service, whose selected Biff branch checks performingBiff. Immediate sync-start failures and empty folder sets have no explicit completion-map update in the selected path. This is static lifecycle evidence, not a reproduced notification or stuck-state failure. No test ran.
title: Exchange Biff completion tracks folder callbacks separately from notification state
